package contracts_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	svc "example.com/interceptorcontracts/gen/contracts"
	rs "example.com/interceptorcontracts/gen/jsonrpc/contracts/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type (
	audit struct {
		t     *testing.T
		sends atomic.Int32
		opens atomic.Int32
	}
	service struct {
	}
	fakeStream struct {
		send string
		ctx  context.Context
		err  error
	}
	contextKey struct {
	}
)

func TestMountedSSEOperations(t *testing.T) {
	a := &audit{t: t}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	rs.Mount(mux, rs.New(svc.NewEndpoints(service{}, a), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil))
	server := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer server.Close()
	response, err := http.Post(server.URL+"/rpc", "application/json", strings.NewReader(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"watch","params":{"id":"one"},"id":"one"}`))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	body, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, response.StatusCode, string(body))
	require.Contains(t, string(body), "notification:audited")
	require.Contains(t, string(body), "final:audited")
	require.Contains(t, string(body), `"id":"one"`)
	require.Equal(t, int32(2), a.sends.Load())
	require.Equal(t, int32(1), a.opens.Load())
}

func TestSSEOperationContextAndErrorDelegation(t *testing.T) {
	sentinel := errors.New("stream failed")
	for _, name := range []string{"send", "final", "error"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			stream := &fakeStream{err: sentinel}
			a := &audit{t: t}
			ctx := context.WithValue(context.Background(), contextKey{}, "operation")
			endpoint := svc.WrapWatchEndpoint(func(_ context.Context, raw any) (any, error) {
				s := raw.(*svc.WatchEndpointInput).Stream
				value := "x"
				switch name {
				case "send":
					return nil, s.Send(ctx, &svc.WatchResult{Value: &value})
				case "final":
					return nil, s.SendAndClose(ctx, &svc.WatchResult{Value: &value})
				default:
					return nil, s.SendError(ctx, "id", sentinel)
				}
			}, a)
			_, err := endpoint(context.Background(), &svc.WatchEndpointInput{Stream: stream})
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
			require.Same(t, ctx, stream.ctx)
			require.Equal(t, name, stream.send)
			want := int32(1)
			if name == "error" {
				want = 0
			}
			require.Equal(t, want, a.sends.Load())
		})
	}
}

func (a *audit) Audit(ctx context.Context, info *svc.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, "contracts", info.Service())
	require.Equal(a.t, "Watch", info.Method())
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorStreamingSend, info.CallType())
	a.sends.Add(1)
	value := info.ServerStreamingResult()
	value.SetValue(value.Value() + ":audited")
	return next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
}

func (a *audit) Observe(ctx context.Context, info *svc.ObserveInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorUnary, info.CallType())
	a.opens.Add(1)
	return next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
}

func (service) Watch(ctx context.Context, _ *svc.WatchPayload, stream svc.WatchServerStream) error {
	value := "notification"
	if err := stream.Send(ctx, &svc.WatchResult{Value: &value}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	value = "final"
	return stream.SendAndClose(ctx, &svc.WatchResult{Value: &value})
}

func (s *fakeStream) Send(ctx context.Context, _ svc.WatchEvent) error {
	s.ctx, s.send = ctx, "send"
	return s.err
}

func (s *fakeStream) SendAndClose(ctx context.Context, _ svc.WatchEvent) error {
	s.ctx, s.send = ctx, "final"
	return s.err
}

func (s *fakeStream) SendError(ctx context.Context, _ any, _ error) error {
	s.ctx, s.send = ctx, "error"
	return s.err
}
